title: Research Problems in Function Theory — Problem 5.11
exact_target: Historical question: does omission of zero together with omission of one by a fixed higher derivative ensure normality? The source update reports an affirmative answer.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 2305011 (AMR-022-5011). CC BY 4.0.
